description: This file contains utility functions for synchronizing user data, including merging tasks, categories, favorite categories, compressing/decompressing sync data, and extracting user data. It also manages external dependencies for data storage and UI notifications.

methods.name: omit
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of an object excluding specified keys.

methods.name: extractOtherData
methods.description: Extracts user data excluding emojis style and fetches profile picture data if stored locally.

methods.name: mergeTasks
methods.description: Merges two task arrays, removing deleted tasks and categories, and resolving conflicts based on lastSave.

methods.name: mergeCategories
methods.description: Merges category arrays, removing deleted categories and resolving conflicts based on lastSave.

methods.name: mergeFavoriteCategories
methods.description: Merges favorite category IDs based on the most recent lastSave timestamp.

methods.name: prepareSyncData
methods.description: Prepares a SyncData object for transmission, including tasks, categories, and other metadata.

methods.name: compressSyncData
methods.description: Compresses sync data into a string for efficient transmission.

methods.name: decompressSyncData
methods.description: Decompresses and parses sync data string back into a SyncData object, restoring date fields.

methods.name: mergeSyncData
methods.description: Merges remote sync data with local data, handling deletions and optional data synchronization based on sync option.
